The ultrasound findings of a disruption in the uterine wall continuity at the previous cesarean scar site, combined with recurrent variable decelerations on fetal heart monitoring and hemoperitoneum, confirm a diagnosis of uterine rupture. This is a life-threatening obstetric emergency requiring immediate surgical intervention.
